description: Stepanov wave, worker adversary (2026-09-26). Witness data produced by experiments/stepanov_adversary_2026_09_26.cpp via the driver. obj = m|B_e(A)| - r_e(A); R_e = obj/((q-1)/2). F_{p^2} elements are indexed u + p*v for u + v*x, x^2 = nu, nu the least non-residue mod p. exh/exhq records are exact maxima over all A of size m (normalised to contain {0,1} or {0,nonsq}); rhp/rect records are search lower bounds. Every witness is re-checked by experiments/stepanov_adversary_2026_09_26.py.
